Title: [Reissue][Request] Validate each Reissue endpoint rejects a request with no x-api-key.
Capabilities / Test Data: Remove x-api-key; Client-Id NDC-Core. Endpoints: POST api/v2/Reissue/Eligibility, /Reshop, /Reprice, /Exchange.
Preconditions: Ticketed Booked PNR on OmanAirV17/EGY on stg-ne-2 (Re-Issue collection environment; confirm before the run), created via V2 Family A (Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> Book -> Retrieve): 1 ADT, one-way MCT-DXB, Economy, departure D+21. Retrieve shows tickets[] populated (one per passenger), booking unflown. pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken and ticket numbers recorded. TC-RI-CAP-01..03 passed.

SpecReference: AN#24; Q21; SPEC §1.5, §7.14; Coll: Postman_Collection/Re-Issue, folder 5. Reissue; SPEC §2.16

Title: [Reprice]&[Exchange][Request] Validate Reshop/Reprice ids obtained under one credentialsSelector cannot be used under another.
Capabilities / Test Data: Reshop under EGY -> R1/O1; Reprice under EGY -> R2/O2. Replay Reprice(R1, O1) and Exchange(R2, O2) with credentialsSelector = the second selector.
Preconditions: Ticketed Booked PNR on OmanAirV17/EGY on stg-ne-2 (Re-Issue collection environment; confirm before the run), created via V2 Family A (Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> Book -> Retrieve): 1 ADT, one-way MCT-DXB, Economy, departure D+21. Retrieve shows tickets[] populated (one per passenger), booking unflown. pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken and ticket numbers recorded. TC-RI-CAP-01..03 passed. A second selector for the same supplier is available (ask the user which one).
Steps / Endpoint Chain: 1. Reshop and Reprice under EGY. 2. Reprice and Exchange with the same ids under the other selector. 3. Retrieve original.
Expected Result: Both rejected (4xx, no offer data). Original PNR and tickets unchanged: Retrieve on the original pnr returns the same itinerary, tickets[] and priceDetails as before the call; no reissued ticket is created.
SpecReference: AC-05; Q21; Coll: Postman_Collection/Re-Issue, folder 5. Reissue/Reprice, /Exchange; SPEC §2.16
Notes: Type: Security | Technique: EG | Gate G0 - runnable with the shared Re-Issue collection. The ids are the only booking reference in Reprice/Exchange, so they must be tenant-bound.
